collectionMethod: Manual capture of the official Command Code GOAT plan page, the pricing-limits resource page and the public pricing page (English) around 10:36 Beijing time / 02:36Z on 2026-11-23: https://commandcode.ai/docs/plans/goat, https://commandcode.ai/docs/resources/pricing-limits and https://commandcode.ai/pricing, read as published. The RSC payload (model catalog + budgetUsd rows on the plan page; models + planBudgetUsd / planAllowanceUsd / availability on the pricing-limits page), the rendered plan-page model tables (context, prices, monthly credits, caps) and the official 'Estimated requests' table were read field by field, and the same three pages captured on 2026-11-21 were compared on budgetUsd / rates / shape / timeOfDay per model. One new paid GOAT model observed (Inkling 2 Mini). Research-only — no adopted row generated, no adopted value changed, no script changed.
scope: Command Code GOAT official catalog only. One new paid model observed on 2026-11-23: 'Inkling 2 Mini' (slug inkling-2-mini, plan-page id 'thinkingmachines/inkling-2-mini', pricing-limits id 'inkling-2-mini'). Vendor Thinking Machines, category opensource, blurb 'compact multimodal reasoning with 1M context', launchedAt 2026-11-20, releaseDate unpublished ($undefined), minPlanName Go, context 1,048,576 tokens, reasoning true, vision true, marked 'not yet scored' (intelligenceIndex and codingIndex unpublished). Priced $0.075 input / $0.30 output / $0.015 cached read per 1M tokens with no cache-write price listed (credits table Cache Write column shows '-'). GOAT per-model monthly credits budgetUsd 15 (credits column '$15'). pricing-limits planBudgetUsd / planAllowanceUsd = {go: 6, goat: 15, pro: 25}. Official estimated requests on the plan page: 3,450 / 5h, 8,620 / week, 17,200 / month (row as published 'Inkling 2 Mini 3,450 8,620 17,200'). Availability includes individual-go / individual-go-v1 / individual-goat / individual-pro / individual-pro-v1 / individual-provider / individual-max / individual-ultra / teams-pro / all, all true. The plan-page counters moved All plans 106 -> 107, GOAT plan 75 -> 76; Deals stayed 3 and Free stayed 2. The plan-page paid budgetUsd rows grew 65 -> 66. The pricing-limits named rows grew 108 -> 109. Other previously listed paid GOAT models keep the same budgetUsd / rates / shape (GLM-5.3 stays at budgetUsd 70). Shared-pool wording did not change. No leaderboard/score data, no adopted.csv row.

previousCapture.note: The 2026-11-21 routine capture of the same pages is used as the baseline. The 2026-11-22 routine scan did not complete, so the comparison is made against 2026-11-21. The last full same-pages GOAT catalog capture with the same counter fields is goat-hy4-round1-2026-11-18.json.

Every other paid GOAT row keeps the same budgetUsd / rates / shape; GLM-5.3 stays at budgetUsd 70. The pricing-limits catalog gained exactly one named row, this model.
